# Complete energy and protocol capabilities in the release

## Goal

Complete energy and protocol capabilities in the release. Complete the work and independent checks listed below for the first public BNG3 release.

## Decision

**[C07/G07 / #152](https://github.com/RuleWorld/BNG3/issues/152), [#177](https://github.com/RuleWorld/BNG3/issues/177): energy additions.** Barrier patterns and driven reservoirs are release features. Verify them with analytic solutions, detailed balance where applicable, cycle affinities and invariants; canonical tools cannot serve as execution oracles for extensions they do not implement.

## Current state

Audited `main` commit: `918a5fb1` (the full hash is in the evidence manifest). The implementation and validation entry points below exist and are the starting points for this work. Their presence is not a claim that all acceptance checks have run.

- `provenance/reconciliation/nfsim.yml` (file present at `918a5fb1`)
- `docs/nonequilibrium_energy.md` (file present at `918a5fb1`)

## Work

1. Map source behavior and existing BNG3 energy/protocol features to explicit capability rows.
2. Implement remaining RNA/uORF, translation, motor, TQSSA, fceRI and multisite protocol behavior.
3. Use canonical comparisons for shared behavior and analytic expectations for barrier/reservoir additions.

## Acceptance criteria

Check identities beginning `release-` below are new named CI acceptance jobs/cases to implement in the independent framework. Existing files above supply the starting implementation/harness. Scientific expected values come from pinned BNG2, native NFsim, PyBioNetGen, official SBML outputs or independent analytic/specification derivations as named; structural checks use the explicit architecture/schema/decision contract. Product-change agents do not author or alter their acceptance answers.

- [ ] `release-energy-protocols`: source-linked corpus executes with matching native NFsim behavior for canonical constructs.
- [ ] `release-extension-protocols`: analytic cycle affinity and driven-protocol expectations pass for BNG3 additions.
- [ ] `release-obligation-152`: each task above has its named check result, source/oracle identity and main commit recorded. For architectural/process work, compare the actual implementation/configuration with the recorded contract, including negative fixtures.

## Dependencies

#143, #177, #180

## Closing rule

Close when every acceptance item passes on `main`. Record the main commit and check artifacts. All maintainer decisions above are final; no further approval is needed.
title: C07: Reconcile newer NFsim energy, Rasi and protocol capabilities
